zh: 金管局與證監會合辦 Project Ensemble 研討會
吸引約200名業界人士參與探討代幣化投資產品
代幣化存款推動 24/7 運作模式並尋求擴大規模
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) co-hosted a seminar on Project Ensemble and tokenised SFC-authorised investment products on 11 November. Around 200 industry practitioners attended the event, which explored scaling tokenisation following the move of tokenised deposits to 24/7 operations.
work.title: Project Ensemble Seeks Scale After Tokenised Deposits Go 24/7

zh: 港交所將於12月14日推出全新數碼支付方案
採用24/7央行數碼貨幣模式處理收市後預繳按金
合資格參與者可在下午5時至凌晨1時30分遞交申請
work.en: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) will launch a new digital payment solution on 14 December to facilitate pre-funded margin payments during the after-hours trading session for derivatives. Built on a 24/7 wholesale Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) model in collaboration with the HKMA, eligible clearing participants can submit margin requests between 5:00 PM and 1:30 AM.
work.title: 港交所下月推出新數碼支付方案 支付收市後交易時段預繳按金

zh: 金管局經貼現窗向銀行投放76.6億元流動性
創下過去近7年以來最大單日放水規模

work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) injected HK$7.66 billion of liquidity into the banking system through its discount window. This marks the largest single-day liquidity injection via the discount window facility in nearly seven years.
work.title: 金管局經貼現窗向銀行放水76.6億 近7年最多
